## Compass Star

**Who:** A recurring male Pegasus background pony in *Friendship is Magic*: espresso-brown coat, golden-yellow mane and tail, bright green eyes, and a yellow star surrounded by four smaller white stars on his flank. He first flies through Cloudsdale beside Rainbow Swoop in **“Sonic Rainboom”**. He also appears with the Pegasus tribe during the **“Hearth’s Warming Eve”** play, joins the pegasi in **“Hurricane Fluttershy”**, and turns up in crowds including **“Friendship University”**. He has **no verified individual dialogue or credited voice actor**; appearing in the pageant does not make him Commander Hurricane. [Character and appearances](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Compass_Star).

**Name:** Unnamed in the TV series, but **Compass Star** is a licensed-media name, first documented on Enterplay’s *Canterlot Nights* collectible card **#55 C**, “**Compass Star, Geography Nut**”. “Geography Nut” is a card subtitle, not a second identity. [Enterplay checklist](https://enter-play.com/products/mlpccg-cn-cardlist.pdf). Gameloft’s G4 mobile game likewise names him Compass Star, describes his sense of direction and forgetfulness, and puts him in **Compass Star’s Observatory** in Canterlot. These details are from the game/card, not spoken show backstory. [Game entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Compass_Star).

**Show still:** *Sonic Rainboom*—Compass Star is the brown Pegasus on the right. Still from the G4 series, archived by the *Friendship is Magic* Wiki; individual screenshot uploader not verified.

[![Compass Star and Rainbow Swoop in Sonic Rainboom](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/3/3c/Rainbow_Swoop_and_Compass_Star_flying_S1E16.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/201?cb=20140811173000)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Compass_Star/Gallery)

**Fan art:** “Did someone say coffee?” by **Steeve** (artist signature and archive tag); the Twibooru copy was **uploaded by Anonymous #E5A6**, not Steeve, and links back to an earlier Derpibooru post. The speech bubble is fan art, **not canonical dialogue**.
